paper.title_en: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity corrections in Dark Dimension scenario
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamics, dynamical stability, and phenomenological implications of Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet (EGB) black holes in Dark Dimension scenarios with one or two micron-sized extra dimensions. For the asymptotically flat, neutral Boulware-Deser solution with positive Gauss-Bonnet coupling $α$, we derive the mass, Hawking temperature, Wald entropy, and heat capacity in arbitrary dimension $D\ge 5$. A positive-heat-capacity branch arises only in $D=5$, where the temperature peaks at $T_{\max}=1/(8π\sqrtα)$ at $r_h=2\sqrtα$ and vanishes in the zero-radius limit at finite mass $M_{\rm lim}=3πα/(4G_5)$. For $G_5=(8πM_*^3)^{-1}$, $α=M_*^{-2}$, and $M_*\sim 10^{10}$ GeV, this yields $M_{\rm lim}\simeq 1.06\times 10^{-12}$ g. While this branch formally overlaps with classical instability zones, the string ultraviolet cutoff safely suppresses the responsible high-harmonic modes. Assuming a UV completion stabilizes these relics, we show they can constitute all of cold dark matter. We map their observational signatures, highlighting a scalar-induced gravitational-wave peak at 33 THz and the suppression of Hawking bursts. In $D=6$, the heat capacity is negative at all radii. Within a bulk blackbody emission model, we derive the leading large-mass lifetime correction and the small-radius scaling $τ\propto M_0^3$, compared to $τ_{\rm GR}\propto M_0^{5/3}$. For $M_*\sim 10$ TeV, we identify distinct collider benchmarks: a steeper energy scaling for the production cross section and a suppressed decay multiplicity ($\langle N \rangle \sim 4$). These provide clear experimental signatures distinguishing 6D EGB gravity from classical General Relativity, mapping the transition toward the string scale.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文在暗维度场景下系统研究爱因斯坦-高斯-博内黑洞的热力学、动力学稳定性与现象学，包含质量、霍金温度、Wald熵、热容的推导，并给出标量诱导引力波、寿命标度和对撞机基准等可观测预言，属于修改引力与黑洞热力学的交叉选题，理论深度与可检验性兼具，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 暗维度场景中的爱因斯坦-高斯-博内引力修正
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在具有一个或两个微米尺度额外维度的暗维度场景中，爱因斯坦-高斯-博内（EGB）黑洞的热力学、动力学稳定性以及现象学含义。对于渐近平直、中性、具有正高斯-博内耦合 $\alpha$ 的 Boulware-Deser 解，我们在任意维度 $D\ge 5$ 下推导了质量、霍金温度、Wald 熵和热容。正热容分支仅在 $D=5$ 中出现，此时温度在 $r_h=2\sqrt\alpha$ 处达到峰值 $T_{\max}=1/(8π\sqrtα)$，并在零半径极限下以有限质量 $M_{\rm lim}=3πα/(4G_5)$ 趋于零。对于 $G_5=(8πM_*^3)^{-1}$、$\alpha=M_*^{-2}$ 以及 $M_*\sim 10^{10}$ GeV，这给出 $M_{\rm lim}\simeq 1.06\times 10^{-12}$ g。虽然该分支在形式上与经典不稳定区重叠，但弦紫外截断可安全地压制导致不稳定的高次谐波模式。假设某种紫外完备化能使这些遗迹稳定，我们表明它们可以构成全部冷暗物质。我们描绘了它们的观测特征，重点指出一个位于 33 THz 的标量诱导引力波峰以及霍金暴发的抑制。在 $D=6$ 中，热容在所有半径下均为负。在一个体黑体辐射模型中，我们推导了大质量下寿命的首阶修正以及小半径标度 $τ\propto M_0^3$，并将其与 $τ_{\rm GR}\propto M_0^{5/3}$ 相比较。对于 $M_*\sim 10$ TeV，我们识别出不同的对撞机基准：产生截面具有更陡的能量标度，且衰变多重数受到抑制（$\langle N \rangle \sim 4$）。这些提供了区分 6D EGB 引力与经典广义相对论的清晰实验特征，描绘了向弦标度的过渡。
